title: Prove the sharp rank-only P104 support floor 96 (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration: the P104 rank-only owned-delivery relaxation has exact minimum **NEED = 96** at rank cap 56. This sharpens the inherited lower bound 90 and classifies every minimizer.

```text
unit diagonal + rank <= 56 + P104 allowed mask
  -> NEED >= 2(104-56) = 96
  -> equality: 48 reciprocal rank-one pairs + 8 singletons
```

DreamingOfClouds's #6170 supplies the P_M identity, rank-to-paid premise, prior bound and abstract 96-entry example. The new contribution is exact optimality, equality rigidity and a witness in the actual orthogonality mask. Gruber's random-order acyclic-set bound and elementary rank/graph facts are classical; no literature-wide priority is claimed for those ingredients. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Ali Romman for PR5599's retained ports and Matarener / #6267 for distinguishing the matrix and physical premises, with the retained P104/native/helper/controller/caller lineage.

Only `research/p104-rank-support-extremizers/` is added. Canonical base is `2485805a6d47f36ea83ddde6327d453ac82d44dc`, priority revision 8. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19294829).

## Evidence

- Before: the cited continuous Jensen relaxation gives NEED >= 90. After: the written integral-degree argument gives the exact minimum 96 and all equality cases over every field. The 104-port witness has exactly 96 off-diagonal nonzeros, rank 56 over Q/F2/F3 and the correct mask. A rational reciprocal-weight witness also has rank 56.
- Local warning-strict normal and optimized checks cover all 4,165 unit-diagonal binary matrices through dimension four, all 739 ternary matrices through dimension three, independent XOR-basis/Leibniz-minor rank routes, 5,460 degree cases and nine controls. Both modes print `PASS_P104_RANK_SUPPORT_EXTREMIZERS` and identical generated hash-bound receipts.
- Metadata/pins and both registered commands pass. Each VERIFY command was timed locally: normal 0.11 s, optimized 0.12 s, well within the 120 s limits. These are execution-budget observations, not performance-improvement claims.
- Exact committed bytes, modes and declared source-history ancestry pass for eight package/input files at `681c547a36e742eceebbde04cb427bcd10cd3293`. Official export and declared-input coverage pass. Both modes pass in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH; all nine exported files retain bytes/modes. Actual source corruption rejects in both modes.

Reproduce from the worktree root with CPython 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/p104-rank-support-extremizers/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/p104-rank-support-extremizers/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-rank-support-extremizers
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-rank-support-extremizers --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Another CPython 3.12 path can replace the local interpreter. The verifier reads the hash-pinned source's port field and never executes its program. No predecessor scientific suite is the deliverable.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The attaining matrix is not a legal owned layer of paid cost 56. The P_M identity and rank-to-paid implication remain cited premises and are not transferred to P' accounting. The exact relaxed optimum shows that rank, diagonal and mask alone stop at 96; it does not settle the physical NEED >= 3597 objective. Gather/landing geometry, shared ancestry, source reads, lifetimes and the complete paid/productive invoice still matter.

No native supplier, selected-frontier change, new kappa or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Selected cold replay, historical suites, Lean and Docker were not run. Every registered local obligation ran; none is deferred to CI alone.

## Related open work

- [#6267](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6267) studies the same P_M owned-delivery matrix and physical floor through lineage factorization, branching and scoped source review. This proves the exact matrix support relaxation and its equality cases; it does not recompute its word counts or resolve its physical NEED premise.

The current open-PR, Discussion, recent-account, main README and merged object/formula searches found no other submission computing this exact extremum. Sparse local-note and unpublished-work coverage remain incomplete; no novelty certificate is implied.

## Open next questions

Which extra owned-geometry condition excludes every 48-pair matrix extremizer under paid <= 56? Start with one actual gather/landing or source-content constraint, retaining shared ancestors and public reads. A complete physical bound is the blocker. This package stops at the first exact relaxation improvement.

**Blast Radius:** isolated. Seven new package files and one unchanged declared input; no shared checker or selected-frontier edits.
